question: Double helical model of DNA was proposed by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Watson and Crick.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

**Watson and Crick**

__
 
• American biologist James Watson and English physicist Francis Crick discovered DNA in the 1950s.
 
• **The double helix structure of DNA was first discovered by James Watson and Francis Crick**, using experimental data collected by Rosalind Franklin and Maurice Wilkins.
 
• They determined that the structure of DNA is a double-helix polymer, the molecule containing human genes.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Robert Hook**

 
• Cell is known to be the fundamental, structural and functional unit in all life forms, including plants, animals, bacteria, and human.
 
• The smallest unit of life, the cell, is often referred to as the "building block" of life.
 
• **The cell was discovered in 1665 by English Botanist Robert Hooke**, one of the first scientists to use a light microscope. 

**Robert Brown**

 
• **Robert Brown, a British Biologist discovered the nucleus in the year 1831.**
 
• This cell organelle was named nucleus according to the Latin word nucleus/ nucleus meaning a seed.
 
• The study of the nucleus is called Karyology.
 
• The nucleus is a double membrane-bound dense protoplasmic body, which controls all the cellular metabolism and encloses the genetic information of the cell.
 
• The nucleus is considered the controller or director of the cell.
